# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna). — v0.13.0
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(demand_response_fhe CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Single package pulls in libnbfhetch + the instrumented OpenFHE headers/libs
# and the openfhe_cprobe_* hooks (Stage 8).
find_package(NiobiumFhetch REQUIRED)

foreach(prog dr_keygen:keygen dr_encrypt:encrypt dr_server:server dr_decrypt:decrypt)
  string(REPLACE ":" ";" pair ${prog})
  list(GET pair 0 tgt)
  list(GET pair 1 src)
  add_executable(${tgt} app/${src}.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(${tgt} PRIVATE Niobium::niobium_fhetch)
  # OpenFHE ships as shared libs; let the binaries find them at run time.
  set_target_properties(${tgt} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN ON)
endforeach()
